title: Candidate-immutable realtime quote to paper-decision wiring

proposal_scope.title: Candidate-immutable realtime quote to paper-decision wiring
proposal_scope.hypothesis: A paper-only coordinator can bind each fresh exact-pair quote to an already frozen non-odds candidate, recompute the existing robust value decision, and append an idempotent shadow event before the internal deadline without changing the candidate or enabling any order path.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The coordinator cannot reliably preserve the frozen candidate identity, quote freshness, decision deadline, and idempotency contracts while producing timely paper decisions.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: Later races require their own near-post market observation because available prices change during the day. The horse combination remains determined by the pre-market racing model; only the separately governed value observation is refreshed for the exact frozen ticket.
proposal_scope.target_population: Synthetic race-time fixtures representing frozen same-race candidates with fresh, stale, missing, changed-hash, late, and duplicate quote-decision events.
stop_conditions: A candidate freeze hash mismatch is not fail-closed
A formal_buy, send_order, or actual stake value becomes active
A production runtime path is imported or executed
A quote or decision deadline contract fails
The registered synthetic manifest hash changes
out_of_scope: Any TARGET handoff or external purchase adapter execution
Any candidate horse or ticket replacement based on odds
Any real-data race-day execution before APPROVED_TO_RUN
Any real-money credential or order transmission
Any threshold optimization or ROI calculation
lineage_hash_requirements: Candidate pair and freeze record hashes must be present and unchanged
Configuration and synthetic fixture manifest hashes must be fixed in the run scope
Decision events must reference the exact quote event and received timestamps
No output may set formal_buy or send_order true or stake above zero
Quote race, ticket type, and canonical selection key must match the frozen candidate
in_scope: Candidate hash verification before every paper decision
Exact race, ticket type, and selection quote matching
Fresh quote and decision deadline fail-close checks
Synthetic fixture tests only during preparation
rejection_gate: Any candidate hash or pair change
Any duplicate paper event for the same idempotency key
Any formal BUY, TARGET handoff, real stake, credential, or order side effect
Any fresh quote accepted for the wrong race, ticket type, or selection
Any real race-day data access during preparation
Any stale, future, missing, or late quote accepted
proposal_scope.data_as_of: 2026-08-01; preparation is limited to the registered synthetic timing manifest and does not read or execute race-day data.

chronological_fold_design.design: Deterministic synthetic contract cases, not a model-performance fold.
chronological_fold_design.ordering: candidate freeze < quote source event <= quote received <= decision < internal hard stop < scheduled post
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real race-day rows may be read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
chronological_fold_design.future_shadow_rule: A separately approved run may append prospective paper rows only after the implementation commit and manifests are frozen.

purge_embargo.candidate_market_firewall: The candidate fixture is frozen before quote attachment.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No result, payout, final odds, or post-time field is permitted.

notes: Paper-only realtime quote wiring proposal. No production, BUY, handoff, or real-data execution.
